programmes.name_local: Bayerisches Programm zur Förderung technologieorientierter Unternehmensgründungen (BayTOU)
programmes.funder: Bayerisches Staatsministerium für Wirtschaft, Landesentwicklung und Energie, operated by Bayern Innovativ GmbH
programmes.amount_note: Maximum grant amount and funding rate are set in the current BayTOU guideline and were not published on the pages verified; recorded as null rather than estimated. Support is given as "a non-repayable grant as part of project funding" covering "R&D personnel costs, costs for instruments and equipment, contract research and obtaining patents".
programmes.deadline_note: No published fixed deadlines; applications handled by the Projektträger Bayern Innovativ.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact Bayern Innovativ / the Gründerlotse Bayern to discuss the project before applying.
Submit the application to the Projektträger against the current BayTOU guideline.

documents_required.doc: Project description of the technically and economically risky development project
Cost plan covering R&D personnel, instruments/equipment, contract research and patent costs

eligibility.other_note: "company founders and young companies in the development of new products, processes and technical services", open to "company founders from all technology sectors" with "technologically and economically risky development projects". Company age limits and grant ceilings are set in the current guideline and were not verified.

programmes.source_snippet: company founders and young companies in the development of new products, processes and technical services

programmes.amount_note: Up to €500,000 in total. Frühphase 1 up to €200,000, split 50/50 between a non-repayable Zuschuss and a Darlehen; Frühphase 2 is loan only. Up to "100 % der förderfähigen Ausgaben" can be covered in both phases.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous; a funding committee decides monthly.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the application digitally via the IBB Kundenportal.
External technical experts assess the project.
IBB carries out the commercial review.
The funding committee decides — it meets monthly.

eligibility.other_note: Berlin-based small technology-oriented companies. Maximum 12 months old for Frühphase 1; maximum 24 months if applying only for Frühphase 2.

programmes.funder: Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Energie (BMWE), operated by Projektträger Jülich
programmes.amount_note: Förderphase I: personnel for up to 4 FTE (3 scientific plus 1 business) and material costs "bis zu 250.000 Euro", which may be exceeded in well-justified cases; duration "bis zu 18 Monate", extendable to 36 months for complex projects. Förderphase II: grant "bis zu 180.000 Euro" on eligible costs of €240,000 at a rate of "bis zu 75 Prozent".
programmes.deadline_note: No fixed Stichtage published on the programme page; applications go through the host institution.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the transfer office of the German university or research institution early.
The institution submits the Phase I application ("Die Antragstellung erfolgt über die Hochschule oder Forschungseinrichtung").
Complete Phase I technology development and start-up preparation, then found the company.
Apply for Phase II from the newly founded company; direct entry to Phase II is "grundsätzlich nicht möglich".

documents_required.doc: Project outline demonstrating scientific preliminary work and basic technological feasibility
Institutional application from the host university or research institution

eligibility.other_note: Project must be hosted at a German university or research institution, with scientific preliminary work and demonstrated basic technological feasibility. The company must not yet be founded in Phase I.

programmes.source_snippet: bis zu 250.000 Euro […] bis zu 18 Monate […] bis zu 180.000 Euro […] bis zu 75 Prozent

programmes.funder: Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Energie (BMWE), operated by Projektträger Jülich
programmes.amount_note: Monthly personal stipend per founder: "Promovierte Gründerinnen und Gründer: 3.000 €", "Hochschulabsolventinnen und Hochschulabsolventen: 2.500 €", "Gründende mit Berufsabschluss: 2.000 €", "Studierende: 1.000 €". Plus "Kinderzuschlag: 150 € pro Kind und Monat", "Sachmittel für Teams: 30.000 €" (or up to €10,000 for solo founders) and a "Coachingbudget: 5.000 €". Paid for twelve months.
programmes.deadline_note: No fixed cut-off dates published; applications are submitted through the participating university at any time.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the Gründungsnetzwerk / start-up support office of a German university or research institution.
Develop the business idea and idea paper with the network; the institution is the formal applicant.
The institution submits the application to Projektträger Jülich; on approval the stipend runs for twelve months.

documents_required.doc: Proof of qualification and study progress for each team member
documents_required.note: Students need at least half the degree completed; graduates within 5 years of graduation

documents_required.doc: Letter of support / hosting agreement from the university or research institution

eligibility.other_note: "Mindestens die Hälfte des Studiums abgeschlossen" for students; "Bis 5 Jahre nach Abschluss" for graduates; researchers also eligible. "max. 3 Personen im Team". The company must not yet be founded at application; the host institution applies on the team's behalf.

programmes.source_snippet: Promovierte Gründerinnen und Gründer: 3.000 € […] Studierende: 1.000 € […] Kinderzuschlag: 150 € pro Kind und Monat

programmes.funder: Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Energie (BMWE), operated by Projektträger Jülich
programmes.amount_note: "Sachmittel in Höhe von 2.000 €" per participant, plus an optional stipend for up to 3 months: students €1,000, with completed vocational training €2,000, graduates €2,500, doctorate holders €3,000, plus €150 per child per month. The programme runs roughly 10 months including mentoring, workshops and network access.
programmes.deadline_note: Participation is via a university or research institution that runs an EXIST-Women cohort; timings set by each institution.

procedure_steps.detail: Find a participating university or research institution ("Antragsberechtigt sind Hochschulen und Forschungseinrichtungen").
Apply to that institution's EXIST-Women cohort with an initial business concept.
Take part in the ~10-month programme: mentoring by the Gründungsnetzwerk, workshops and the online platform; receive Sachmittel and, if granted, the stipend.

documents_required.doc: Proof of status as student, graduate or researcher at the institution

eligibility.other_note: Targets "Studentinnen, Absolventinnen, Wissenschaftlerinnen" at universities and research institutions with an interest in founding and an initial business concept. Universities and research institutions are the formal applicants.

programmes.source_snippet: Sachmittel in Höhe von 2.000 € […] Antragsberechtigt sind Hochschulen und Forschungseinrichtungen

programmes.funder: Ministerium für Wirtschaft, Industrie, Klimaschutz und Energie des Landes Nordrhein-Westfalen
programmes.amount_note: "1.200 Euro pro Monat. Für 1 Jahr" per founder. Gender-diverse teams receive "1.500 Euro statt 1.200 Euro pro Monat" plus a one-off bonus of up to €3,600 per person.
programmes.deadline_note: TEMPORARILY PAUSED: due to high demand the jury sessions are suspended — "pausieren die Jurysitzungen ab dem 01.04.2026 vorerst". Applications already submitted continue to be processed. No reopening date was published at the time of verification.

procedure_steps.detail: Choose an accredited Gründungsnetzwerk in NRW.
Develop the innovative business idea with the network's support.
Pitch the idea to the network's jury; on approval the stipend runs for one year — jury sessions are currently paused.

documents_required.note: Presented to the jury of an accredited founding network

eligibility.other_note: For people "die in die Start-up-Szene einsteigen wollen" with an innovative business idea in North Rhine-Westphalia. An uplift applies to gender-diverse founding teams. Awarded as de minimis aid; the de minimis basis was not restated on the page verified.

programmes.source_snippet: 1.200 Euro pro Monat. Für 1 Jahr […] pausieren die Jurysitzungen ab dem 01.04.2026 vorerst

programmes.amount_note: Phase 1 (6 months): the founder's previous Arbeitslosengeld amount plus €300 per month. Phase 2 (9 months): €300 per month towards social security cover. The individual total depends on the founder's ALG I entitlement, so no fixed maximum.
programmes.deadline_note: Applied for at the point of taking up self-employment, while ALG I entitlement remains.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm at least 150 days of remaining Arbeitslosengeld entitlement.
Obtain a Tragfähigkeitsbescheinigung from a fachkundige Stelle (IHK, HWK, bank or business consultant) confirming the long-term viability of the business.
Submit the application online through the Bundesagentur für Arbeit portal with the supporting documents.
After 6 months, apply for the second phase (€300/month for 9 months).

documents_required.note: IHK, HWK, banks or business consultants

documents_required.doc: Proof of remaining ALG I entitlement

eligibility.other_note: Founder must be receiving Arbeitslosengeld, have at least 150 days of remaining entitlement and work at least 15 hours per week hauptberuflich in the new business. It is an Ermessensleistung (discretionary), not an entitlement — the agency must be convinced of the venture's prospects.

programmes.amount_note: EQUITY, NOT A GRANT. "Der Sweet Spot unserer Erstinvestitionen in Pre-Seed und Seed liegt bei 800.000+ Euro." "In Wachstumsrunden können wir bis zu 30 Millionen Euro in ein Startup aus unserem Portfolio investieren." Follow-on capital is reserved for existing portfolio companies only.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous; pitch decks accepted at any time via the 'Mein Pitch' form.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit a pitch deck via the 'Mein Pitch' form on the HTGF website.
Screening and due diligence by the relevant sector team.
Investment as lead investor, typically alongside co-investors from the HTGF network.

eligibility.other_note: "Wir investieren frühphasig in Unternehmen, die nicht älter als drei Jahre sind." Focus sectors: "Digital Tech, Industrial, Climate & Deep Tech, Life Sciences, Chemie oder angrenzenden Tech-Bereichen". Company must be headquartered in Germany or have a German operating base. This is an equity investment, not public aid.

programmes.source_snippet: Der Sweet Spot unserer Erstinvestitionen in Pre-Seed und Seed liegt bei 800.000+ Euro. […] Wir investieren frühphasig in Unternehmen, die nicht älter als drei Jahre sind.

programmes.amount_note: Paid to the investor, not the startup. Erwerbszuschuss of "15 Prozent des Ausgabepreises seiner Anteile"; minimum investment "mindestens 10.000 Euro"; maximum €333,333.33 per single investment (€50,000 grant) and €666,666.66 lifetime per person (€100,000 grant). Exit-Zuschuss of "25 Prozent des Gewinns aus der Veräußerung", capped at the original acquisition subsidy. Up to €3m of eligible investment per company per calendar year.
programmes.deadline_note: Open continuously; the guidance on market-standard clauses was revised with effect from 1 May 2025.

procedure_steps.detail: The startup applies to BAFA for a Förderfähigkeitsbescheinigung confirming it is a young innovative company.
The investor acquires new shares (minimum €10,000) and holds them for the minimum holding period.
The investor applies to BAFA for the Erwerbszuschuss after the investment.
On a later sale at a gain, the investor may apply for the Exit-Zuschuss.

documents_required.note: Obtained from BAFA before the investment

documents_required.doc: Share purchase / investment agreement and proof of payment

eligibility.other_note: Company must be "jünger als sieben Jahre", have "weniger als 50 beschäftigte Personen" and "Jahresumsatz oder eine Jahresbilanzsumme von höchstens 10 Millionen Euro", be a Kapitalgesellschaft or eingetragene Genossenschaft with a German operating site, and be innovative. Aid is granted as de minimis.

programmes.source_snippet: 15 Prozent des Ausgabepreises seiner Anteile […] mindestens 10.000 Euro […] 25 Prozent des Gewinns aus der Veräußerung […] jünger als sieben Jahre

programmes.amount_note: "maximal 200.000 Euro pro Vorhaben", of which "maximal 80.000 Euro für Betriebsmittelfinanzierungen". KfW gives the on-lending bank an "80-prozentige Haftungsfreistellung". Terms: up to 10 years with at most 2 repayment-free years, or up to 5 years with at most 1 repayment-free year. Merkblatt Stand: 18.06.2026.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous; applications must be made before the project starts.

procedure_steps.detail: Prepare the business plan and financing plan.
Approach a Hausbank or other financing partner — KfW does not lend directly.
The Hausbank submits the application to KfW before the project begins.
On approval, sign the loan contract with the Hausbank and draw down the funds.

eligibility.other_note: "Existenzgründern und jungen Unternehmen" — founders, freelancers and companies less than 5 years in the market meeting the EU small-enterprise definition. Applied for through a Hausbank.

programmes.source_snippet: maximal 200.000 Euro pro Vorhaben […] maximal 80.000 Euro für Betriebsmittelfinanzierungen […] 80-prozentige Haftungsfreistellung

programmes.amount_note: "maximal 500.000 Euro pro Antragsteller". A subordinated loan (Nachrangkredit) treated as quasi-equity, requiring no collateral. "Kreditlaufzeit: 15 Jahre, davon 7 Jahre tilgungsfreie Anlaufjahre". The Hausbank receives a "100-prozentige Haftungsfreistellung auf Grundlage einer Bundesgarantie". Merkblatt Stand: 01.01.2022.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous; application must be made before the project starts.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm the business has been operating for less than 3 years.
Contribute own funds of "15 % (alte Länder) beziehungsweise 10 % (neue Länder und Berlin) der förderfähigen Kosten".
Apply through a Hausbank, which passes the application to KfW.
On approval, the subordinated loan is disbursed with 7 repayment-free years.

documents_required.doc: Evidence of the required own contribution (Eigenmittel)
documents_required.note: 15% old Länder / 10% new Länder and Berlin

eligibility.other_note: Business must "noch keine 3 Jahre bestehen" since starting operations. The loan strengthens the equity base and requires no collateral from the borrower.

programmes.source_snippet: maximal 500.000 Euro pro Antragsteller […] Kreditlaufzeit: 15 Jahre, davon 7 Jahre tilgungsfreie Anlaufjahre […] noch keine 3 Jahre bestehen

programmes.funder: Mikromezzaninfonds Deutschland, delivered by the regional Mittelständische Beteiligungsgesellschaften
programmes.amount_note: "Die maximale Beteiligungshöhe beträgt 100.000 Euro bei einer Laufzeit von 10 Jahren. Für Zielgruppen-Unternehmen liegt die maximale Beteiligungshöhe bei 150.000 Euro." Provided as a stille Beteiligung (silent participation) — economic equity without voting rights; repayment from year 7 in three equal annual instalments.
programmes.deadline_note: Continuous, through the Mittelständische Beteiligungsgesellschaft of the applicant's Bundesland.

procedure_steps.detail: Prepare a business plan.
Submit the completed funding application with the business plan to the Mittelständische Beteiligungsgesellschaft of your Bundesland.
On approval, the silent participation runs for 10 years with repayment from year 7.

eligibility.other_note: Target groups qualifying for the higher €150,000 ceiling include businesses founded by unemployed people, companies led by women or people with a migration background, socially oriented enterprises and ecologically sustainable businesses. Granted as de minimis aid.

programmes.source_snippet: Die maximale Beteiligungshöhe beträgt 100.000 Euro bei einer Laufzeit von 10 Jahren. Für Zielgruppen-Unternehmen liegt die maximale Beteiligungshöhe bei 150.000 Euro.

programmes.amount_note: Maximum grant amounts and funding rates are set in the ZIM-Richtlinie and were not stated on the pages verified; recorded as null rather than estimated. Funds market-oriented R&D projects, technology- and sector-open.
programmes.deadline_note: TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED: a befristeter Antragsstopp applies "ab 7. Juli 2026, 12:00 Uhr" for "alle Projektformen sowie Projektskizzen". Applications already submitted will still be approved where funds allow, and international cooperation applications are excepted. "Eine Aufhebung der Aussetzung der Antragsannahme wird für Anfang 2027 angestrebt."

procedure_steps.detail: Choose the project form: FuE-Einzelprojekt, FuE-Kooperationsprojekt (at least two companies, or one company and a research institution), or Innovationsnetzwerk.
Submit the application fully digitally via the Förderzentrale Deutschland — currently suspended until the Antragsstopp is lifted.

documents_required.doc: R&D project description and work plan

eligibility.other_note: "unterstützt innovative KMU über die Förderung von Forschung und Entwicklung marktorientierter FuE-Projekte". Exact KMU headcount and turnover limits were not stated on the verified page.

programmes.source_snippet: ab 7. Juli 2026, 12:00 Uhr […] Dies gilt für alle Projektformen sowie Projektskizzen […] Eine Aufhebung der Aussetzung der Antragsannahme wird für Anfang 2027 angestrebt
